## 3. Per run and mode

p >= t: p_somatic at or above the run's validation recall-0.9 threshold (the PASS rule). Truth: every chr1 somatic truth SNV once (its best tensor). After PoN: on-reference tensors whose GRCh38 allele is not in the four PoNs (SNV rule). x base: germline tensors >= t relative to base.
